metadata.source_title: Comparison of treatment of renal calculi by open surgery, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, and extracorporeal shockwave lithotripsy
metadata.verification: Bibliography and aggregate 273/350 versus 289/350 verified against the publisher abstract. Stratum counts are the published example explicitly supplied by the user and cross-checked against the UCSD teaching transcription linked in notes.
metadata.observational_caution: Documented observational treatment comparison. Do not infer causal superiority of either treatment; stone size is associated with both treatment selection and outcomes.

claim: The aggregate observed treatment success rate is higher for percutaneous nephrolithotomy than open surgery; this is a descriptive comparison, not evidence of causal superiority.
source_citation: Charig CR, Webb DR, Payne SR, Wickham JE. BMJ 1986;292:879-882. doi:10.1136/bmj.292.6524.879. PMID:3083922.
transcription_notes: Only the requested open-surgery and percutaneous arms are included. Counts sum to 273/350 and 289/350. Stratum transcription also appears at https://cseweb.ucsd.edu/classes/sp16/cse21-bd/slides/day21_S16_Lecture_B.pdf . Binary expansion is a computational representation, not recovered patient-level data. Runtime loading is entirely local.
